Terms of Service

By using tripto.to you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

Using the service

You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure.
Do not attempt to disrupt, reverse engineer, or gain unauthorized access to the service.
Your content

You keep ownership of the trip data and documents you add. You grant us only the limited permission needed to store, process, and display that content back to you across your devices.

Accuracy of travel information

tripto.to assembles a timeline from the details you provide or forward. We do our best to parse them correctly, but you remain responsible for verifying dates, times, and confirmations directly with airlines, hotels, and other providers. We are not liable for missed bookings arising from inaccurate or incomplete data.

Availability

The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. Features may change and the service may be unavailable at times. We save your local data on your device so it stays with you.

Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
